The minimal physical-time CTMC is nonexplosive and positive recurrent on its irreducible state space.
quantifiers: Every finite r and finite nonempty list of nonzero cofactor vectors nu_j; all overlaps/orders allowed; one A-controlled substrate B; independent 0<->C_i immigration/death; all fixed positive rates satisfying the strict inequality.
supplied_vs_acquired: Network, stoichiometries, and rational rates are supplied. epsilon,R,N are acquired by terminating exact search on rational inputs. No stochastic trajectories or numerical solver are acquired.
proof_evidence: Analytic H bound and all-state generator split in RESULT.txt; independent cold audits are complete in audit_weighted_affine/REPORT.txt and audit_hostile_g/REPORT.txt, with the sharpened-H receipt in audit_hostile_g/SHARP_H_BOUND.txt. Exact finite replay at verify_mixed_fixture.py is diagnostic only.
costs: H0 and the strict margin are computed from the input list. The epsilon=1/k, R=1+1/k^2 search terminates by N=O(k), R^(N-1)->1 and g_+(R)->0. Exact rational arithmetic decides each finite search step; no polynomial runtime bound is claimed. The fixture replay checks 7,200 states.
strongest_control: The bounded exact source audit is LITERATURE_AUDIT.txt. The fixture fails Anderson-Kim Theorem 4.2's general stochastic tier gate on (A,B,C,D)=(0,n,n,2); it also fails the binary/single-linkage gate of Anderson-Cappelletti-Kim Theorem 4.1 and the pure-drain/strong-endotactic gates of Anderson-Cappelletti-Kim-Nguyen Theorem 7.2. Wiuf-Xu is one-dimensional, while the base stoichiometry has rank r+2. Product-form results cover only the complex-balanced slice. Failure of these sufficient criteria is not a recurrence counterexample.
falsifier_scope: The theorem does not assert all-rate recurrence. If kappa<=0, this particular proof is silent; no recurrence counterexample follows. Mixed cofactor death can have a nonzero asymptotic H contribution, which is explicitly bounded rather than discarded.
